app.tagline: Co-op bomb defusing for your table
language.label: Language
home.active_game: Your game in room :code is running
home.big_table_note: The printed game is for 2–5 players. Tables of 6–8 use this edition's extended rules.
lobby.title: Lobby
lobby.waiting_for_host: Waiting for the host to start…
lobby.waiting_ready: Waiting for everyone to be ready
lobby.kicked: The host removed you from this room.
lobby.game_in_progress: This game has already started without you.
lobby.errors.cannot_kick_self: You can't remove yourself. Leave the room instead.
lobby.errors.capacity_below_players: There are already more players than that.
lobby.errors.host_only: Only the host can do that.
lobby.errors.invalid_capacity: Table size must be between :min and :max.
lobby.errors.room_not_found: No open room with that code.
game.title: Mission
game.setup_hint: Tap one of your wires to reveal its value to everyone.
game.setup_waiting: Waiting for the others to place their info tokens…
game.hide_wires_hint: Press and hold your wires to see them.
game.pick_target: Tap a teammate's wire to cut it
game.dual_cut_hint: You can only name a value you hold yourself.
game.solo_cut_hint: You hold every remaining wire of these values. Cut them safely:
game.log.info: :player revealed a :value with an info token.
game.log.begin: All info tokens are placed. :player (Captain) starts.
game.log.dual_cut_fail: :actor said :value for :target's wire #:position, but it's a :actual. The detonator ticks!
game.won_text: Every wire is cut. The bomb is defused.
game.lost_text: Too many wrong cuts. Regroup and try again.
push.reveal: Room :room: your teammates need you to reveal a wire.
push.nudge: :name is waiting for you in room :room!
push.offer: Want a ping when it's your turn or a teammate calls you back?
push.failed: Couldn't turn on notifications on this phone.
push.install_hint: On iPhone, add this page to your Home Screen and open it from there to get notifications.
game.errors.nudge_cooldown: You just nudged them. Give them a moment.
game.errors.nudge_invalid: You can only nudge a teammate in this game.
game.errors.nothing_to_undo: There is no move to undo.
game.waiting_for_host: The host will take everyone back to the lobby.
game.errors.info_already_placed: You've already placed your info token.
game.errors.setup_not_finished: Wait until everyone has placed their info token.
game.errors.not_a_player: You're not playing in this game.
game.errors.not_own_wire: Pick a teammate's wire, not your own.
game.errors.value_not_held: You can only name a value you hold yourself.
game.errors.wire_has_info: That wire already has an info token.
game.errors.no_game: There is no game running in this room.
game.reveal_red_hint: Only red wires are left on your stand. Show them and you're done!
game.log.dual_cut_stabilized: :actor said :value for :target's wire #:position, but it's a :actual. The Stabilizer held!
game.log.equipment.rewinder: :actor used the Rewinder: the detonator goes back one step.
game.log.equipment.post_it: :actor put a Post-it on their wire #:position: it's a :value.
game.log.equipment_cancel: :actor switched the :card back off. It's still available.
game.errors.info_blue_only: Info tokens go on blue wires only.
game.errors.reveal_red_not_allowed: You can only reveal when nothing but red wires is left on your stand.
game.errors.equipment_not_in_play: That equipment isn't part of this mission.
game.errors.equipment_used: That equipment has already been used.
game.errors.equipment_not_cancellable: That equipment can't be taken back now.
equipment.guide_hint: Every card in the game. Each mission deals some of them; the green ones are in this mission.
equipment.guide_random: :count of these are dealt at random when the mission starts.
equipment.guide_unlock_hint: The card's number: depending on the mission, it unlocks after two (or all) wires of that number are cut.
equipment.how.wire: Pick one of your blue wires, then confirm
equipment.how.pair: Pick two neighbouring wires of yours, then confirm
equipment.how.switch_off: can be switched off again until a wrong cut uses it up
equipment.your_turn_only: You can use equipment on your turn. It doesn't end your turn.
equipment.pick_wire: Tap one of your blue wires.
equipment.pick_pair: Tap the left wire of two neighbours.
equipment.stabilized: Stabilizer on: your next wrong cut this turn is free.
equipment.label.name: Label
equipment.label.text: Mark two neighbouring wires of yours as equal or different.
equipment.post_it.name: Post-it
equipment.post_it.text: Put an extra info token on one of your blue wires.
equipment.radar.name: Radar
equipment.radar.text: Name a number: everyone shows whether they still have one.
equipment.stabilizer.name: Stabilizer
equipment.stabilizer.text: Your next wrong cut this turn won't tick the detonator.
equipment.rewinder.name: Rewinder
equipment.rewinder.text: Turn the detonator back by one.
mission.1.name: First Day
mission.1.briefing: Blue wires only. Learn to cut together.
mission.2.name: Steady Hands
mission.2.briefing: Still all blue, but the fuse is shorter.
mission.3.name: Yellow Alert
mission.3.briefing: Two yellow wires join in. You know which ones.
mission.4.name: Hide and Seek
mission.4.briefing: Two yellow wires, hidden among three possible values.
mission.5.name: One, Two, Three
mission.5.briefing: 4s, then 8s, then 12s: cut them in that order.
mission.6.name: Yellow First
mission.7.name: Red Alert
mission.7.briefing: A red wire appears. Never cut it!
mission.8.name: Which One Is Red?
mission.8.briefing: One red wire, and it could be one of two values.
mission.9.name: Toolbox Lock
mission.9.briefing: Equipment only unlocks once all four wires of its number are cut.
mission.10.name: The Long Chain
mission.11.name: Emergency Kit
mission.11.briefing: Shorter fuse. The Rewinder and the Stabilizer only work after your first mistake.
mission.12.name: Double Trouble
mission.13.name: Rainbow Order
mission.13.briefing: Yellow, then 3s, then 7s, with two red wires lurking.
mission.14.name: Tight Spot
mission.14.briefing: Short fuse, hard-won equipment, two reds.
mission.15.name: Countdown
mission.15.briefing: 1s, then 6s, then 12s, with plenty of colour.
mission.16.name: The Big One
mission.16.briefing: Three reds, four yellows, a cut order and almost no help. Good luck!
mission.label: Mission
mission.title: Mission :number
mission.unlock.cut_pair: each unlocks after 2 cuts of its number
mission.unlock.cut_all: each unlocks once all 4 of its number are cut
mission.unlock.after_mistake: they unlock after the first mistake
game.pass_hint: The cut order blocks every move you could make right now. Skip this turn.
game.errors.sequence_locked: Not yet! Every :first has to be cut first.
game.errors.pass_not_allowed: You can still make a move.
game.errors.equipment_locked_cut_pair: This unlocks once two :value wires are cut.
game.errors.equipment_locked_cut_all: This unlocks once every :value wire is cut.
game.errors.equipment_locked_after_mista: This unlocks after the first mistake.
equipment.locked_cut_pair: Unlocks when two :value wires are cut
equipment.locked_cut_all: Unlocks when every :value wire is cut
detector.name: Double Detector
detector.text: Once per game: point at two wires on one teammate's stand and name a value you hold. If either matches, it's cut.
detector.pick_two: Tap two wires on one teammate's stand.
detector.hint: If one of them matches, it's cut. If none does, the detonator ticks and :name shows you one of them.
detector.reveal_prompt: :actor said :value for your wires :positions, but none of them is. Choose one to show everyone.
detector.waiting: Waiting for :name to reveal one of the wires…
game.log.double_detector_success: :actor used the Double Detector on :target's wires #:first and #:second: wire #:position was a :value!
game.log.double_detector_fail: :actor used the Double Detector on :target's wires #:first and #:second for :value. Neither! The detonator ticks.
game.log.double_detector_stabilized: :actor used the Double Detector on :target's wires #:first and #:second for :value. Neither, but the Stabilizer held!
game.errors.detector_used: You've already used your Double Detector.
game.errors.waiting_for_reveal: Wait until the Double Detector wire is revealed.
game.errors.nothing_to_reveal: There's nothing for you to reveal.
game.errors.detector_pick_one: Pick one of the two wires the detector pointed at.
errors.too_fast: Whoa, slow down a little! Try again in a moment.
detector.pick_three: Tap three wires on one teammate's stand.
game.log.detector_many_success: :actor used the :card on :target's wires :positions: wire #:position was a :value!
game.log.detector_many_fail: :actor used the :card on :target's wires :positions for :value. None! The detonator ticks.
game.log.detector_many_stabilized: :actor used the :card on :target's wires :positions for :value. None, but the Stabilizer held!
game.log.equipment.walkie_talkies: :actor used the Walkie-Talkies: :target swaps a wire with their wire #:position.
game.log.equipment.emergency_batteries: :actor used the Emergency Batteries: :players can use the Double Detector again.
game.log.equipment.coffee_mug: :actor had a coffee and passed the turn to :player.
walkie.prompt: :actor gives you their wire #:position. Tap one of your wires (without an info token) to give back.
walkie.waiting: Waiting for :name to pick a wire to swap…
equipment.pick_swap: Tap one of your wires without an info token.
equipment.pick_stand: Tap any wire on a teammate's stand.
equipment.pick_players: Recharge whose Double Detector? Pick one or two.
equipment.super_prompt: Name a value you hold for :name's whole stand.
equipment.xy_prompt: Name two values you hold for :name's wire #:position.
equipment.batteries_none: Nobody has used their Double Detector yet.
equipment.how.swap: Pick one of your wires, then a teammate; they pick the wire they give back
equipment.how.detector: Pick three wires on one teammate's stand, then a value (this is your cut)
equipment.how.stand: Pick a teammate, then a value (this is your cut)
equipment.how.xy: Pick a teammate's wire, then two values (this is your cut)
equipment.label_different.name: Label ≠
equipment.label_different.text: Mark two neighbouring wires of yours that are different.
equipment.label_equal.name: Label =
equipment.label_equal.text: Mark two neighbouring wires of yours that are the same.
equipment.walkie_talkies.name: Walkie-Talkies
equipment.walkie_talkies.text: Swap one of your wires for one a teammate chooses from their stand.
equipment.triple_detector.name: Triple Detector
equipment.triple_detector.text: Like the Double Detector, on three wires of one teammate.
equipment.super_detector.name: Super Detector
equipment.super_detector.text: Like the Double Detector, on a teammate's whole stand.
equipment.emergency_batteries.name: Emergency Batteries
equipment.emergency_batteries.text: Recharge one or two used Double Detectors.
equipment.xy_ray.name: X or Y Ray
equipment.xy_ray.text: A Dual Cut naming two values you hold: either one counts.
equipment.coffee_mug.name: Coffee Mug
equipment.coffee_mug.text: Skip your turn and choose who plays next.
game.errors.label_equal_untrue: Those two wires aren't the same.
game.errors.label_different_untrue: Those two wires are the same.

game.errors.walkie_nothing_to_swap: That player has no wire to swap.
game.errors.batteries_not_used: That Double Detector hasn't been used yet.
game.errors.coffee_pick: Pick another player who still has wires.
